basic_profile.bio: I am a 27-year-old living in the Midwest, currently balancing my time between school and a co-op position at a small accounting firm. My interests revolve around accounting, technology, and maintaining a healthy lifestyle, which is reflected in my frequent visits to subreddits like HealthyFood and ArcRaiders. I'm also exploring more technical topics like Solarwinds and dabbling in philosophical economic discussions in free_market_anarchism. I am single and enjoy spending my evenings online, typically between 7 PM and midnight, after a day of classes and work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in accounting, I am currently honing my skills through academic courses and my co-op job. My knowledge extends into technology, particularly interested in how it intersects with my field, and I'm also self-teaching through various online resources.
